# GUI demo font

Noto Sans Regular is an unmodified, trusted application font distributed under
the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see LICENSE).

Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/blob/ffebf8c1ee449e544955a7e813c54f9b73848eac/hinted/ttf/NotoSans/NotoSans-Regular.ttf

SHA-256: b85c38ecea8a7cfb39c24e395a4007474fa5a4fc864f6ee33309eb4948d232d5

The rasterizer is stb_truetype v1.26, pinned to the same stb revision as the image
decoder: 013ac3beddff3dbffafd5177e7972067cd2b5083. Its SHA-256 is
a34d8d536ce7c11b9163ab2d524721c1f4df1452cce6595c4f11d3048384f925.
The existing ../stb/LICENSE covers both stb headers.
